intro: The way new members join RWB has changed.
This short video explains the new flow, step by step.
list: RWB has one master member list.
The app shows it, and our Google Sheet keeps a copy.
Now they stay in sync both ways.
Change the app, or change the sheet, and the other updates by itself.
notapp: Being a member is not the same as having the app.
Some members use the app, and some don't.
They are all members. Deleting the app changes nothing.
join: There are two ways to join: the join form on our website, or a request from the app.
Either way, nobody becomes a member straight away.
Every new entry waits in the Approvals list.
checks: One. Is this a new member, or an existing member filling the form again?
Two. Do they own a Ronin?
Four. Did they agree to the RWB rules?
applist: Tap the banner on Home to open the Approvals list.
Each card shows the four checks, and a score out of four.
vrn: Checking the VRN is done by you, the admin.
Copy the number, and check it on Parivahan, or with the rider.
If another member already has the same VRN, you'll see a warning.
appapprove: Tap Copy to copy the VRN.
After checking, tick VRN verified. The score becomes four out of four.
Then tap Approve. They're added to the member list, and the Google Sheet.
appreject: Something not right? Here, the rider has no Ronin.
Tap Reject, and pick a reason.
Their sheet row moves to the Rejected tab.
appexisting: This one is an existing member, filling the form again.
Approving simply updates their details. No duplicate is created.
sheet: In the Google Sheet, a new column called App Status keeps track.
New entries show Waiting for approval.
Rejected rows move to the Rejected tab, and old duplicate rows move to Older entries.
appnew: After approving, add them to WhatsApp.
In the RWB tab, tap New, then tap a member.
edit: Edit them in the app, or right in the Google Sheet. Both stay in sync.
Two small tips: change one phone number at a time.
And clearing a cell in the sheet does not erase it in the app.
appremove: When someone leaves, open their profile, and tap Remove from RWB.
Pick a reason, add a short note, type REMOVE, and confirm.
results: They disappear from the member list.
Their app login and data are deleted.
Their sheet row moves to the Removed members tab.
And admins can still see them, under Left or removed.
apprestore: Tap Left or removed, open them, and tap Restore.
appbikes: One more new thing: members can add up to three bikes in their profile.
Admins verify each VRN, and verified numbers get a green tick.
donts: Deleting a row in the sheet by hand does not remove anyone.
And uninstalling the app does not remove anyone either.
Always use the Remove from RWB button.
rules: To sum up, four simple habits.
One. Check the four points, and approve entries every day.
Two. Check New every week, and add them to WhatsApp.
Three. Edit details in the app, or in the sheet.
Four. Remove members only with Remove from RWB.
outro: Thank you for looking after our warriors.
